verdict.rationale: Jira's features page directly claims pre-built, customizable project templates covering agile sprints through marketing campaigns, which matches the story of jumpstarting a new project. The evidence is a single marketing line, and no community or hands-on item addresses templates either way. Missing for 10: in-depth docs listing the template catalog and what each template pre-configures, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the template onboarding experience.
